description: Accept, decline, or tentatively accept an event invitation. By default the organizer is sent the response, with the optional comment, straight away; a declined event is normally removed from the user's calendar. An accept or tentative response can be changed by calling this tool again; after a decline the event may be gone, so changing it may not be possible here.

comment.description: Optional message sent to the organizer with the response

name: respond_to_event
